# warcraftlogs

Warcraft Logs official API CLI.

## Global options

Pass these before the subcommand: `warcraftlogs --pretty <command> ...`.

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--site` | str | retail | Warcraft Logs site profile: retail, classic, or fresh. |
| `--pretty` | boolean | false | Pretty-print JSON for human reading. Default output is compact JSON. |
| `--compact` | boolean | false | Truncate long string fields to reduce payload size. |
| `--fields` | str (repeatable) |  | Return only selected fields (dot paths). Repeat or pass comma-separated values. |
| `--fields-strict` | boolean | false | Fail when a requested --fields dot-path is missing from the payload. |
| `--profile` | str |  | Output profile preset: agent (default compact JSON) or human (pretty JSON). |
| `--compact-max-chars` | int range | 280 | Maximum string length before --compact truncation adds an ellipsis. |

## warcraftlogs search

Match an explicit Warcraft Logs report URL or code; free text returns a discovery hint.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `query` | str | required | Explicit Warcraft Logs report URL or report code. |

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--limit` | int range | 5 | Accepted for wrapper compatibility; explicit report discovery returns at most one result. |

## warcraftlogs kill-time-distribution

Bucket kill durations across a sample of recent kills of one boss.

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |

| `--zone-id` | int | required | Warcraft Logs zone ID to sample reports from. |

| `--boss-name` | str |  | Boss name to match within sampled fights. |
| `--difficulty` | int |  | Optional difficulty ID filter. |
| `--spec-name` | str |  | Optional sampled participant spec filter applied before aggregation. |
| `--kill-time-min` | float |  | Optional minimum kill time in seconds. |
| `--kill-time-max` | float |  | Optional maximum kill time in seconds. |
| `--report-pages` | int range | 1 | How many report-list pages to sample. |
| `--reports-per-page` | int range | 25 | Reports to fetch per sampled page. |
| `--start-time` | float |  | Optional report-range start time in milliseconds. |
| `--end-time` | float |  | Optional report-range end time in milliseconds. |
| `--guild-region` | str |  | Optional guild-region scope for report discovery. |
| `--guild-realm` | str |  | Optional guild-realm scope for report discovery. |
| `--guild-name` | str |  | Optional guild-name scope for report discovery. |
| `--bucket-seconds` | int range | 30 | Bucket size in seconds for the returned histogram. |

## warcraftlogs graphql

Run a raw Warcraft Logs GraphQL query, or introspect the schema with --introspect.

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--query` | str |  | GraphQL operation text, @path, or - for stdin. |
| `--var` | str (repeatable) |  | GraphQL variable in key=value form. Value is JSON-coerced when possible. |
| `--variables-json` | str |  | JSON object of GraphQL variables. |
| `--operation-name` | str |  | Optional GraphQL operation name. |
| `--endpoint` | str | auto | Endpoint family: auto, client, or user. |
| `--cache-ttl` | int range | 0 | Opt-in cache TTL in seconds. Defaults to 0/off. |
| `--introspect` | boolean | false | Run a GraphQL introspection query. |
| `--allow-unlisted` | boolean | false | Inject allowUnlisted=true when the query declares $allowUnlisted. |
| `--report-code` | str |  | Inject report code into declared $code variables. |
| `--fight-id` | int (repeatable) |  | Optional fight ID filter. Repeat as needed. |
| `--encounter-id` | int |  | Inject declared $encounterID variables. |
| `--start-time` | float |  | Inject declared $startTime variables. |
| `--end-time` | float |  | Inject declared $endTime variables. |
| `--difficulty` | int |  | Inject declared $difficulty variables. |
| `--zone-id` | int |  | Inject declared $zoneID variables. |
| `--source-id` | int |  | Inject declared $sourceID variables. |
| `--target-id` | int |  | Inject declared $targetID variables. |
| `--ability-id` | int |  | Inject declared $abilityID variables. |

## warcraftlogs auth

Warcraft Logs authentication helpers.

## warcraftlogs auth status

Report saved Warcraft Logs credentials, token state, and public/user API readiness.

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--no-live` | boolean | false | Skip live Warcraft Logs auth probes and report local/runtime readiness only. |

## warcraftlogs auth client

Show the configured OAuth client and the endpoints of the selected site profile.

## warcraftlogs auth token

Summarize the saved user token: type, expiry, and granted OAuth scopes.

## warcraftlogs auth login

Start (or complete with --code) the authorization-code login that grants a user token.

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--redirect-uri` | str | required | Registered redirect URI for the Warcraft Logs OAuth client. |
| `--code` | str |  | Authorization code returned by the redirect callback. |
| `--state` | str |  | State value returned by the redirect callback. |
| `--scope` | str (repeatable) |  | OAuth scope. Use view-user-profile for currentUser/user data and view-private-reports for private/guild-stealth reports. Repeatable. |

## warcraftlogs auth pkce-login

Start (or complete with --code) the PKCE login that grants a user token without a client secret.

**Options**

| Option | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--redirect-uri` | str | required | Registered redirect URI for the Warcraft Logs OAuth client. |
| `--code` | str |  | Authorization code returned by the redirect callback. |
| `--state` | str |  | State value returned by the redirect callback. |
| `--scope` | str (repeatable) |  | OAuth scope. Use view-user-profile for currentUser/user data and view-private-reports for private/guild-stealth reports. Repeatable. |

## warcraftlogs auth logout

Delete the saved Warcraft Logs user token from local state.

## warcraftlogs auth whoami

Show the Warcraft Logs account the saved user token belongs to.
